title: Lines without a tech story look the same as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · the production app or an older screenshot · about 10 minutes
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 No Story Look" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset.
  • Work order [WO-1] for this customer: status Approved, a line "Line 1" and no tech story.
  • A way to see the same kind of line before this release: the current production app, or a screenshot taken before the release.
  • The line name is an example.

Setup

  1. Top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST F3 No Story Look" > Save (skip if it already exists). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Record the customer as [Cust-1].
  2. Create a work order with one line: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in New Work Order pick Customer [Cust-1] and its Asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line, turn Line Approved on (this makes the work order Approved) > Save & Add Line for the next line or Save & Close. Record the number shown as [WO-1]. Line names in this case (such as "Line 1") are only labels for you: the New Line form's "What Are You Doing?" box only offers ready-made lines (typed text finds no results), so pick any ready-made line for each one (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot") and write down which is which.
  3. Check the setup worked: [WO-1] reads Approved and its Lines tab shows Line 1 with no tech story. Have the production app or the older screenshot open before starting; if neither is available, the comparison in step 3 cannot be made.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order [WO-1] and click the Lines tab.
  2. Look at Line 1 (its Story row and add-story prompt).
  3. Compare it with the same kind of line before this release.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Line 1 looks exactly as before: the same add-story prompt and layout, no new mark and nothing missing.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10051 (Story 8, Remove the tech story check-mark indicator); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S8-N1, read 8 Oct 2026. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
